Comparable data on main reason for divorce are available from 2004 onwards.  The category on  Divorce by mutual agreement  is only available from 2024 onwards as it was introduced as an additional fact on 1 July 2024. A fact refers to one of the legally recognised circumstances (such as adultery, unreasonable behaviour, separation or divorce by mutual agreement) that must be proven to show that a marriage has irretrievably broken down.
